blocks.text: Best Red Light Panel​s

Our experts used data from independent tests and customer reviews to select the 10 best devices in each category. In this ranking, you will find an option of top rated red light therapy panels​ to suit your taste. From more targeted use, such as for the face, to more versatile functionality for the full-body. One of the main advantages of it – the LED therapy is quite safe. When comparing specifications, we took into account power, coverage area, wavelengths, and additional features such as PEMF or Smart Control. Let’s have a look at [biohacking red light](https://www.biohackers.world/blog/red-light-therapy-biohacking-methods-for-health-benefits) and how we could use it at home.

**The MitoPRO 1500 by Mito Red Light** is one of the most successful models in terms of combining power and a scientific approach. The panel provides clinical effectiveness, modular connection, and quiet cooling. Pros: high intensity, reliability, 5-year warranty. Cons: bulky, requires a separate space. Price: $1,295. Power: 1500 W.
Best Budget Option – The Red Mini by UltraLux Health

This option is suitable if you are looking for something less expensive but still effective. Best Targeted Pad – Hooga HG300 Pad

If you are interested in localised treatment, for example, of the back or other large areas of the body,**the Hooga HG300 Pad** can help. Pros: comfort, affordability, good light bioavailability. Cons: small area of exposure, limited service life. Price: $279. Power: 300 W.
Best for Sauna Use – Clearlight Red Light Tower

This panel aids detoxification and relaxation in the sauna. Pros: heat resistant, premium quality. Cons: high price, stationary installation. Price: $1,495. Power: 1600 W.

blocks.text: Red Light Therapy Panel Comparison

Now that we have read about and understood the most successful panel models, let’s analyse them in a table. Here you will see the 10 models discussed above, which our experts have compiled in a table to make it easier for you to visually analyse and compare them.
How We Selected the Best Red Light Therapy Panels
The modern market is overflowing with variations of infrared panels. Therefore, in order to choose the most effective one, it is important to adhere to certain points.

items: Certification and scientific verification. Make sure that the device you are considering has all the necessary certificates and has been tested in laboratory conditions. This way, you will not end up with an experimental model and will be satisfied with the result.
Appearance. Since you will be using this device frequently, it is important that you like it. Choose according to your taste, because you will be interacting with this item on a regular basis.
Compare different products and do not look at the brand only. Make a list of the top rated red light therapy panels​ and choose the one based on the experts reviews as well.
Power intensity. It is important that the device has a power of at least 100 mW/cm². With a lower indicator, you will not achieve a therapeutic effect.
Wavelengths. Choose the optimal ranges of 630-660 nm and 810-850 nm. At this wavelength, the light penetrates the skin surface sufficiently.
Safety. Do not forget about this point, as you will be interacting with the device quite often. Make sure that the EMF level is low. Also, make sure that there is no flickering on the panel.
Functionality. The presence of smart modes on the device will be a plus. A user-friendly interface is also important.

Summary

Today we learned more about the best red light therapy panels for home​ and understood how they benefit our health in general. Such devices can reduce inflammation, improve joint function and allow muscles to rest well after strenuous workouts. They also have a visible anti-ageing effect. Infrared light helps stimulate collagen growth and tightens the skin.
Therefore, these panels can improve your health both inside and out. In order to choose the right red light therapy panels, you need to consider several factors.

items: Check out red light therapy panel reviews​ on different sources. Learn more about the market, which items are worth paying attention to and which are not worth the money.
Don’t forget about scientific verification. It is important that the item that will come into contact with your skin is scientifically proven and safe for you.
Choose modern options with smart modes.
Keep an eye on the power intensity, as too weak won’t make sense and too powerful will dry your skin.
The same thing with the wavelength. It should range from 630-660 nm and 810-850 nm. That length is enough to stimulate muscle relaxation and skin rejuvenation.
